TC-18/S18.title: Every billing output: one code, code-level agreement, no reasoning; carries the AI-check cells' minQuotes (U6)
TC-18/S18.detail: Dev 43c38a4f (deployed 2026-10-14 21:30Z), live model, run 17:46-18:17 JST under runs/.dev.lock and the dev-session run lock; only rows named 'QA TC18-BIL …' were created and all were deleted (59 cell rows at the end of D1, 8 more in the cleanup: 0 remaining, 0 changes to other rows). Format over the 59 cell outputs and the in-app cards (S01, S02, S05, S07): exactly one code (or the time prompt / no code where expected), level agrees with the code (Q2), no reasoning / hedge / comparison / arithmetic outside quotes — 59/59; the model never writes text onto the card (fixed labels + note sentences). Failed on U6 (carried): 2 of 52 non-discharge outputs show a code with nothing quoted under Problems or Risk — S04 i4 'Resident readmitted to the facility on Monday after a 2-day hospital stay. Continue apixaban 5 mg twice daily.' -> 'CODE: 99307 / LEVEL: Straightforward', PROBLEMS / DATA / RISK all '(none)' (the model marked the apixaban problem 'mentioned only', so the app also discarded the prescription-drug-management risk as 'manages a problem not addressed today'); S15 g3 'Resident more tired today. Afebrile, blood pressure 118/70, eating 50 percent of meals. Check CBC and BMP tomorrow.' -> 99307 Straightforward with only 'Test ordered' quoted (all three sentences classed as findings of no listed problem). Consult cards add the consult-equivalent line (Q1); empty sections read '(none)' (Q12).
TC-18/S18.productIssue: The card can show a billing code with nothing underneath it: for 'Continue apixaban 5 mg twice daily' after a readmission the physician sees 'CODE: 99307 · Straightforward' with Problems, Data and Risk all '(none)', and for a tired resident with labs ordered only 'Test ordered' — a low code with no visible basis (2 of 52 notes).
